title: Seo 2003: csa anatomical of erector spinae at L3-L4 (M, supine)

imaging.plane: transverse cross-sectional image at L3/4 (orientation relative to disc not stated)

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction); planimeter area on the transverse MRI image; mean of right and left sides (one-side value)

source.authors: Seo A, Lee JH, Kusaka Y
source.sample: 250 subjects (152 M, 98 F); healthy Japanese volunteers without back-pain treatment, age 15-75

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine (lying; lordosis as when lying, no gravity load on trunk).
Select all erector spinae fascicles whose path crosses the plane at L3-L4 (transverse cross-sectional image at L3/4 (orientation relative to disc not stated)), one side.
Sum their PCSA; divide each PCSA by cos(angle between fascicle and plane normal) to get anatomical CSA.
Compare the one-side total with the measured mean +/- SD (bilateral sums are labelled side=bilateral_sum).
protocol.notes: Paper does not say whether multifidus is included in "erector spinae" (size ~24 cm2/side in men suggests the whole paraspinal mass). cm2 -> mm2.

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 single-line rows, unambiguous in text; re-read all values. verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Table 1a males 20-29: CSAES 24.7 (5.1) cm2, N=38; L3/4, mean of R/L)
